title: AlfaGen Logs

targets.expr: sum by (service_name) (count_over_time({namespace=~"alfagen-prod|alfagen-bench", namespace=~"$namespace", service_name=~"backend|backend-generate|admin", service_name=~"$service"} | json log_msg="msg", log_status="status", log_level="level" | (log_msg!="http_request" or log_status!~"[23][0-9]{2}" or log_level!~"(?i:info|debug)") | drop __error__, __error_details__, log_msg, log_status, log_level [$__interval]))

sum by (service_name) (count_over_time({namespace=~"alfagen-prod|alfagen-bench", namespace=~"$namespace", service_name=~"backend|backend-generate|admin", service_name=~"$service"} | json log_msg="msg", log_status="status", log_level="level" | (log_msg!="http_request" or log_status!~"[23][0-9]{2}" or log_level!~"(?i:info|debug)") |~ "(?i)(error|fatal|panic|warn)" | drop __error__, __error_details__, log_msg, log_status, log_level [$__interval]))

{namespace=~"alfagen-prod|alfagen-bench", namespace=~"$namespace", service_name=~"backend|backend-generate|admin", service_name=~"$service"} | json log_msg="msg", log_status="status", log_level="level" | (log_msg!="http_request" or log_status!~"[23][0-9]{2}" or log_level!~"(?i:info|debug)") |~ "$search"

description: Бизнес-события backend/backend-generate и admin. Успешные HTTP access/probes и инфраструктурные сервисы исключены. Ошибки HTTP 4xx/5xx, WARN/ERROR и бизнес INFO сохраняются.
